name: Focus session finishes into timeline with prayer anchors

planSteps.description: Complete onboarding, press the Focus button to start a quick focus session. Pause the timer, resume it with Continue, then finish the session early. Open the Timeline page.
The finished session appears as a timeline entry, and five prayer markers for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha with Arabic names are visible on the timeline.
